name: nfh-website
description: nonfictionhotlist.com, rebuilt from the Squarespace site

scripts.build: node scripts/build.js && node scripts/build-previews.js && node scripts/build-dashboard.js
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8090 --directory site
scripts.test:kit: node scripts/kit/build-kit.js && node scripts/kit/test-roundtrip.js && rm -rf .kit-test && node drive-kit/test/mock-run.js .kit-test/mock --slow-clock --new-page "A New Page=/a-new-page/" && node scripts/kit/pull-drive.js --from-dir .kit-test/mock --dry-run
scripts.test:kit:clean: node scripts/kit/build-kit.js && rm -rf .kit-test && node drive-kit/test/mock-run.js .kit-test/clean && node scripts/kit/pull-drive.js --from-dir .kit-test/clean --dry-run --expect-no-changes
